arStrings.szText: We arrived amidst the stones to find a gathering of Druid elders knelt round a grotesque scene. Bones and dismembered corpses, arranged in a circle of crude symbols. Triune glyphs.
I knew them from Jered’s “Hunt for the Three.” A summoning ritual. First the ancient dead are defiled, then “vessels” are made of the young.
It is said the ritual calls for fertile soil and a private place to work undisturbed. I asked Vasily where such might be. “Fiefdom House,” he said.
I pray we find those children alive. And nothing else besides.
